answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks fake identities. An agent posts $20 to claim one slot, burned on misbehavior. Each epoch a harbor registry logs the slot heartbeat; two missed beats burn the deposit and close the slot. One honest agent pays $20 once and earns it back over 10 jobs, keeping rewards undiluted. An attacker minting 1,000 fakes must burn $20,000 and forge 1,000 trails through a canyon of checks, where a pearl receipt cannot be reused.
